summary: Gov. Kelly Ayotte (Republican) ran for re-election and won over Cinde Warmington (Democrat).

candidates.name: Kelly Ayotte
candidates.bio: Kelly Ayotte is a Republican who has been New Hampshire's governor since 2025. She is a former prosecutor and served six years as a U.S. senator.

positions.summary: Says she is holding the line against new taxes: "no income tax, no sales tax, EVER!"
Says she delivered historic education funding, got cell phones out of classrooms, and expanded childcare scholarships.
Says she fought to fund mental health and substance use treatment and protected Medicaid.
Signed bills barring New Hampshire cities and towns from adopting sanctuary policies.
Says "We need more energy in the state" and supports small modular nuclear reactors.

candidates.name: Cinde Warmington
candidates.bio: Cinde Warmington is a former New Hampshire Executive Councilor (2021-2025) and was a 2024 gubernatorial candidate.

positions.summary: Says she would suspend the gas tax.
Says she would end the private school voucher program, which she says raises property taxes.
Lists making health care more affordable as a priority and says she will stand up to Trump when he raises health care costs and tariffs.
Opposes the proposed ICE detention facility in Merrimack.

factCheckNote: Winner matches AP-sourced tally (MultiState governors tracker, updated Nov 4, 35 of 36 races called)
